paired_seed_rule: The same seed is used at matched q/off/SC coordinates in the two geometry engines; paired traces are not counted as independent cross-system evidence.

range_rationale.q: ordinary-scale density from 0.1 to 10 plus two-sided limiting-reagent controls
range_rationale.off_weight: log-spaced 0.01 to 1500, matching the requested three-order-plus range
range_rationale.SC: author values plus 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4 to resolve the pilot transition

supersedes: v1 was quarantined because the inherited depth-3 bond-fragment search could retain disconnected components.
